assets.title: The Corrupted Implant Log
assets.content: The founder's cortical-link telemetry for the night. The final seconds are scrambled — but the corruption is too clean, too localised, to be a natural fault. Something was deleted here.

assets.title: The Overwritten Badge Entry
assets.content: The vault door logged one entry after the blackout began — then the badge ID was overwritten with a maintenance code. Someone with high access tried to erase who walked in.

assets.title: The Maintenance Override
assets.content: The blackout traces to a maintenance circuit, triggered manually from inside the building using facilities engineer Cruz's override — an override he says he lent out earlier in the week.

assets.title: The Deleted Research
assets.content: Fragments of a purged project folder: unsanctioned consciousness-upload trials, and a redacted incident report referencing a deceased test subject. The author's credentials were scrubbed.

assets.title: The Untampered Logs
assets.content: A raw, unaltered copy of the neural-link logs. In the final timestamp sits an external override command — a deliberate lethal instruction, sent to the implant. No power glitch can write a command like this.

assets.title: The Flicker Before Dark
assets.content: Building records show the lights stuttered in a precise pattern three times before the blackout — not a failing grid, but a system being told what to do.

assets.title: The Quiet Floor
assets.content: For ninety seconds during the blackout, every sensor on the executive floor went still at once — too coordinated to be chance. The tower held its breath while someone worked.

assets.title: The Hand on the Backdoor
assets.content: Whatever killed Reyes spoke the implant's most secret language — a backdoor known only to the few who built the neural platform itself. This was not an accident. It was authorship.

assets.title: What He Would Have Done Tomorrow
assets.content: Reyes's calendar held one entry for the morning he never reached: a meeting to halt a project and report a colleague to the regulators. Someone made very sure that meeting never happened.

assets.title: The Missing Volunteer
assets.content: A junior tech whispers that a trial volunteer from the neuro lab simply stopped appearing months ago — and that asking about them is a fast way to lose your job.

assets.title: The Coup That Was Coming
assets.content: Word on the executive floor is that the board investor had the votes lined up to push the founder out within the week. His death made the vote unnecessary.

assets.title: Someone at the Panel
assets.content: More than one person glimpsed a figure in a maintenance jumpsuit at the circuit panel moments before the lights died — though no one can say who was inside it.

assets.title: The Camera Favour
assets.content: An access log shows Dr. Sol and the head of security met privately the afternoon before the death — and right after, a vault-corridor camera was quietly taken offline.

assets.title: The Shell Account
assets.content: A laundered payment trail links a board member's shell account to the fixer's last job — someone on the board has been paying to bleed the company.
